dedupe_keys.name: public perception of safety on public transport

description: Public Perception of Safety on Public Transport is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Regional Development. The report contains data on public perception of how safe it is to use public transport: whether they currently use public transport, if they feel safe, what makes them feel unsafe, what would make them feel safer and if this stops them using public transport. Coverage: Department for Regional Development. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Regional Development. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
